record_note: Written 2026-10-06, after the fact: this repo was wired by hand from the kit's C++ templates (first commit d27b5a5, the Stage-A scaffold) before this record existed, so `revision` is NOT the exact copy point — it is the newest kit commit any recorded file was taken from (d888e29, the hook-tier fix), and the earlier entries came from kit revisions between then and now. Kind is `retroactive` for that reason. The two fixes in `adopted_fixes` are the two probes this copy carries; every other kit fix is neither claimed nor declined, which the record checker reports with the result of running the kit's probe against this gate — silence is not a claim. Rule that keeps this file true: any commit that edits a copied artifact updates that artifact's repo_sha256 in the same commit, and a commit that moves `revision` re-reads every kit_sha256. On 2026-10-06 the carried copy of tools/kit-probes/gitignore-footprint.sh was replaced with the kit's verbatim probe at 742ee17 (the probe that derives the footprint list from the gate under test) — the copy this repo had was hand-adapted, which a claim cannot prove. Its `from_revision` names that probe's own revision for the same reason; the recipe it guards came from acced82 (D15). **2026-10-06, probe re-sync:** the copy of tools/kit-probes/hook-tiers-agree.sh here was the one taken at d888e29. The probe gained two refinements while the fleet was ported -- it reads a full tier single-sourced as CI_DEFAULT_STAGES (four sibling repos spell it that way and have no list in their push hook at all), and it reads the gate's own --list before calling a stage a decoration, because JSOM's `coverage` is declared opt-in. Without them the probe reported those repos as having no tiers. The copy is the kit's current file, revision and adopted_fixes[hook-tiers-agree].from_revision both name 919006e, and every kit_sha256 is re-read at that copy point.
